model.name: merge.applyAllNonConflicting
model.description: The 'Apply All Non-Conflicting' toolbar action opens a popup (automagic) offering 2 auto-resolve modes: (1) accept-all so CENTER matches the LEFT file (LEFT wins); (2) accept-all so CENTER matches the RIGHT file (RIGHT wins). NAMING-TENSION FLAG for architect+PO: the label says 'Non-Conflicting' but the 2 modes describe accept-ALL-by-side (left/right wins, which also resolves true conflicts) - clarify scope (only-non-conflicting vs all-by-side) at design-derive. Rides the R30.35 add/remove side-into-center model (addSide 843d79d4 / removeLine af887908).
